pages.title: Village Friends
paragraphs: Six villagers live in the valley: Rosa the baker, Old Tom the fisherman, Juniper the artist, little Pip, Hazel from the village shop and Bram the blacksmith.
Tap the Village button at the bottom of the screen to see them all. Each card shows how many hearts you have with that villager, out of 10.

There are three ways to make friends. Give each villager one gift a day. Chat with them when they visit your farm: tap them once a day for a little friendship. And fill their orders: every order on the Order Board is signed by one of them.

Every villager loves some things, likes others and dislikes a few. A loved gift gives 40 friendship, a liked one 20, anything else 8, and a disliked one takes 20 away. Silver star gifts give 25% more and gold star gifts 50% more.
What they love starts as a question mark. Each gift you give shows you how they feel about it, and their page remembers it for you.
Birthdays are special: on a villager's birthday a gift counts three times, and they write to thank you the next day. You can see every birthday on their page.

pages.title: Hearts and rewards
paragraphs: 100 friendship makes one heart. Friendship never goes down while you are away, so play at your own pace.
At 2 hearts the villager writes you a letter with a useful tip.
At 4 hearts they share a story with you, the next time you are relaxing on your farm, and give you a keepsake decoration. Find it in the Barn, under Stored, and place it anywhere.

At 6 hearts you get their special gift: Rosa's berry tart recipe, two extra free casts from Old Tom, four new paint colours from Juniper, a treasure from Pip every Monday, 10% off at the travelling merchant from Hazel, or workshops that work 5% faster thanks to Bram.
At 8 hearts there is a second story and a framed portrait of them for your farm.
At 10 hearts you are best friends. Their card gets a gold frame, and they send you a present every week.
